yacl3.config.slotplus:config.title: SlotPlus
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.enabled.des: Master switch for the bind gesture and the swap triggers. On by default.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.hotbarShift: Shift-clicking a bound hotbar slot swaps it with its bound partner instead of moving the item to the main inventory. Off by default.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.creativeSup: Also allow binding and swapping while the creative inventory is open. Swaps there use the exact clicks of a manual number-key hotbar swap in creative. Takes effect the next time the inventory is opened. Off by default.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.keybindNote: The bind key can be rebound in Options > Controls > Key Binds.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.inventoryPa: Bind two main-inventory slots to each other. NEU considers anything besides hotbar binds cheat territory, so this is off by default, and the mod asks every time you enable it (with a don't-show-again option). Swaps here take two ordinary clicks: middle-click one slot, then its partner. Nothing is automated; it's the same as moving them by hand.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.showTutoria: Tick to see the binding tutorial again the next time you open your inventory. It unticks itself once the tutorial has been shown.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.showPartner: Show hotbar numbers on bound slots
Draw the paired hotbar slot's number on top of each bound slot. On by default.
slotplus.tutorial.title: SlotPlus
slotplus.tutorial.line1: Hold [%s] and click an %s to start a bind.
slotplus.tutorial.line2: Then %s (or drag and release over) a %s to finish.
slotplus.tutorial.line3: %s a bound slot to swap it with its %s.
slotplus.msg.swapPending: Middle-click the %s to finish the swap (same slot cancels)
slotplus.msg.armor: Armor can't be bound, it's kind of attached to you. Try /loadouts.
slotplus.msg.offhand: The offhand can't be bound. It's a free spirit.
slotplus.msg.crafting: Crafting slots can't be bound. They forget everything anyway.
slotplus.warning.title: Inventory-to-inventory binds
slotplus.warning.body:
SlotPlus (much like NotEnoughUpdates) only binds slots to the hotbar. According to NEU, binding inventory slots to each other would need cheats; that may be true, may be outdated, or may just be their opinion.

What's certain: SlotPlus only ever sends the same ordinary clicks you'd make with your own hand, at your own pace. Nothing automatic, nothing a human couldn't do.

Hypixel isn't transparent about what is and isn't allowed, so nobody can promise you'll never be flagged. But nothing crazy is happening to the server here.
